text.Factory World:
Factory World Factory World.jpg Colony Wars Trade Federation Outpost 6 defense 8 1 3 Put the next ship or base you acquire this turn into your hand. 
 How to Play ==
When you play Factory World you gain 3 Trade and you may put the next ship or base you acquire this turn into your hand. Factory World is an Outpost with a defense of 6.
 Strategy ==
This first time you read this card you probably awed:"Wooot"? Adding 3 Trade to your Purchase Power and adding the next card you buy into your hand, i say again your hand....do i need to say more?
